figurative_meaning_en: Friend or companion only in good times
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সব বন্ধু বসন্তের কোকিল, সুখের সময়ে পাশে থাকে কিন্তু দুঃখে কেউ আসে না।
জীবনে বসন্তের কোকিলের মতো লোক এড়িয়ে চলা উচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: All his friends are like spring cuckoos; they stick around during good times but vanish in trouble.
In life, one should avoid people who are fair-weather friends like the spring cuckoo.
note: This idiom draws from Bengali rural imagery of the cuckoo bird singing vibrantly in spring, symbolizing fleeting companionship.
